messages:
Diego L.: Hi @people-ops — married last week, my spouse's child (stepchild) will move in from abroad in a couple months. Can I add them to benefits now or wait until they arrive/SSN issued?
Cam (People Ops): Congrats! You can start a QLE for "gaining a dependent" based on the date they move into your household. If theyre still abroad, you can submit placement docs now to start provisional review.
Diego L.: I have a family court custody letter from their home country and a notarized guardianship letter. Translation pending. Passport/SSN pending too.
Nadia (Benefits): That's workable. For provisional enrollment we usually need custodian/placement docs + evidence they'll live with you (sponsor/lease or school intent). Translated docs should follow, but we can accept originals + translator attestation for now.
Diego L.: If it's provisional, will premiums start immediately or only once translated/SSN provided? I'm worried about surprise retro deductions.
Nadia (Benefits): If you enroll within the 30-day QLE window measured from the placement/move-in date, coverage is effective back to that date and payroll will retro-adjust. For international documentation delays, include courier/tracking and translator timeline and request an "exception - translation delay" in the portal. We can temporarily defer retro collection while docs are pending.
Diego L.: 30 days might be tight; embassy processing slow. What's the file naming and upload path?
Cam (People Ops): Benefits portal -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent (QLE). File names like lopez-maya-custody.pdf and lopez-maya-guardian-translation-pending.txt. If files are >20MB use SFTP and paste the receipt in the submission notes.
Diego L.: And dependent care FSA? If I add them now can I open DC FSA midyear?
Nadia (Benefits): Yes, a dependent QLE allows changes to Dependent Care FSA midyear. Elections prorate from effective date. You can submit claims for eligible expenses incurred after the effective date.
Diego L.: Anything I should redact in the custody letter? It mentions other families.
Cam (People Ops): Redact unrelated personal info but keep the placement language visible. If you need help, mention "REDACT-HELP" in the portal and Ops will assist.
Diego L.: How long until review? Can I get this expedited — spouse starts work next pay cycle and we need coverage lined up.
Nadia (Benefits): Standard review 3 business days for complete submissions. For timing risks add note "expedite - payroll cutoff" and DM me the SFTP receipt; we'll fast-track. Exceptions for translation/immigration delays take 5-7 business days.
PayrollBot: Payroll flag queued: pending-retro-adjustment for lopez-maya. Exception note: translation pending if requested.
Diego L.: Uploading now: lopez-maya-custody.pdf, lopez-maya-guardian.pdf, lopez-maya-school-intent.pdf. Adding portal note: "Request provisional enrollment; translation incoming; expedite if possible." Thanks! :raised_hands:
Cam (People Ops): Got it — we'll follow up here once Benefits reviews. DM if you need a faster ping. :thumbsup:
